peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.8% above its local comparables; 35 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (45.6): 3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 41 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 58.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,800,000 ($1,608 psf, 1,119–1,130 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,549 psf (range $1,404–1,568); 3.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $66,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lorong Chuan MRT about 120 m, Serangoon MRT about 990 m; closer than 85 of 94 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest ST. Gabriel's Primary School about 140 m; more than 73 of 94 similar developments (the same as 16). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 990 m), more than 6 of 94 similar developments (the same as 15); nearest hawker centre Serangoon Garden Market about 1,450 m; nearest park Kallang Linear Park about 680 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 360 m; Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 1,850 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,850 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 96 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 150 new sales and 468 resales (618 purchases); new sales were 24.3% of these purchases. Subsales (26) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: One Chuan Grove (government land sale site, awarded, about 1,060 homes), about 280 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 468 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 45 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 468 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 571 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−18%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
